responsibility: Contains the principal RTL machine description for the Visium target. It declares target constants, attributes, unspec codes, and includes the predicates and constraints files, then defines the instruction patterns, expanders, splitters, output templates, delay-slot behavior, prologue/epilogue RTL forms, comparison and cstore lowering, block move/set insns, and other recognition/emission rules that translate GCC RTL into Visium assembly while exposing scheduling-relevant instruction types.
same_name_distinction: The RTL machine-description file for Visium: unlike visium.cc it describes instruction recognition, expanders, attributes, and assembly templates in md form rather than C++ hook code, unlike visium.h it is not a macro configuration header, and unlike visium.opt it specifies insn patterns and scheduling-visible attributes rather than command-line options.
